title: Sea Level Flood Map parameters
$comment: Slider granularity is x-step, NOT multipleOf. multipleOf is checked by floating-point division, and 1.4 / 0.1 is 13.999999999999998 - so a schema declaring multipleOf 0.1 rejects 16 of the 51 positions its own slider can reach. x-step draws the control; minimum and maximum do the validating. x-panel splits the controls in two: representation is how the map is drawn, assumptions is what the model is made of. Property ORDER is the reading order inside each panel. x-shown-when removes a control that means nothing in the current state; x-disabled-when grays one whose value another control is deciding, and its value may be a LIST, meaning any one of these takes the control over.

view.title: Show
view.description: The first view fills in one storm at today's sea level and draws where it reaches under each of the four projections for the chosen year. The second draws all four storms and all sixteen lines at once, flat.

aep.title: Storm, by how often
aep.x-disabled-note: overridden by the surge set by hand
aep.description: NOAA's exceedance levels for the Battery: the water level with a 99%, 50%, 10% and 1% chance of being exceeded in a given year. "None" is today's high tide, so the four lines then show sea level rise alone.

basemap.title: Shade by water depth
basemap.description: Shading shows how deep the water is over each cell. The all-storms view is always flat.

flood_line.title: Flood line
flood_line.description: The edge of the fill, drawn as the wet cells next to dry ones. The four projection lines are always drawn.

year.title: How far ahead
year.x-disabled-note: overridden by the sea level set by hand
year.description: The five horizons NPCC4 publishes. All four projection lines are drawn for the chosen horizon.

tide.title: Tide state
tide.x-disabled-note: a storm level already includes high tide
tide.description: The Battery's tidal datums: mean lower low water, mean sea level and mean higher high water, on the 1983-2001 epoch. A storm level already contains a high tide, so this control is taken over when a storm is chosen.

connectivity.title: Hydraulic connectivity
connectivity.description: With connectivity on, a place floods only if water can reach it from open water at that waterline. With it off, every low place floods, including inland dips the sea cannot reach; those cells are drawn red.

slr_by_hand.title: Set sea level by hand
slr_by_hand.description: Replaces the four projections with one number of your own. The four lines collapse to one.

surge_by_hand.title: Set the surge by hand
surge_by_hand.description: Replaces the published storm levels with a height of your own, added to the tide.
